AGO.note: Nothing on rules or an authority for AI harms.
Only a pledge to keep investing in AI; no AI system named in service.
Minister only says Angola will keep investing in AI for clinical decisions; no tool named as piloted or in service.
No national AI model, dataset or compute stated.
A health-sector strategy is described, not a national digital strategy.

facts.fact: Health Minister Silvia Lutucuta said the ministry has implemented DHIS2 as the main national health data management platform.
Health Minister Silvia Lutucuta said DHIS2 has been implemented as the main national health data management platform, integrating different information platforms and producing analytical dashboards.
